fasta: the two contigs the records and the pruned cache's transcripts sit on (10 and scaf_307) at their full length from Zea_mays.Zm-B73-REFERENCE-NAM-5.0.dna.chromosome.10.fa.gz and Zea_mays.Zm-B73-REFERENCE-NAM-5.0.dna.nonchromosomal.fa.gz of Ensembl Plants release 63, every base outside the regions a run reads (each cached transcript's span with 5,000 bases of flank and each record with 2,000) masked to N; reference.fa.gz beside this file, compressed with bgzip, with reference.fa.gz.fai and reference.fa.gz.gzi for the compressed file and reference.fa.fai for its decompressed form; Ensembl VEP received the decompressed file as --fasta on every run
input: variants.vcf: 254 records on chromosome 10 and the unplaced scaffold scaf_307. 189 come from tools/vep-seeded-variants (--records wide, seed 1, generator version 2) run over the converted cache and the genome sequence of the two sequences, their IDs naming the situation and an ordinal: under the standard genetic code a start codon, a stop gained and a stop lost; a missense and a synonymous change on each strand; a splice donor and a splice acceptor; both untranslated regions; an intron; upstream, downstream and between genes; a frameshift insertion, a frameshift deletion and an in-frame deletion; the first and the last base of each sequence; and exon records on the first sequence, the last sequence and the scaffold. 65 are single-base substitutions sampled with seed 1 from the cache's known variants on the two sequences, their IDs the cache's identifiers; all 65 lie on chromosome 10. Two exemplars per consequence-set combination the two references show, stratified by variant class and strand, six per combination carrying a protein-level term, plus the records the manifest's included_records name: the first eight generated records of each situation, every first-base and last-base record, and sixty known variants evenly spaced along chromosome 10. Every transcript of the cache names genetic code 1, no sequence of the cache is circular and its synonyms file is empty, so the generator writes no record for a codon read differently, for an origin or for a synonym. The chromosome names are the cache's on both sides and no synonyms file is needed

pruned_cache.variation_slices: the known variants within one base of a record under variations/<chr>/all_vars.gz with its .csi, as the Ensembl VEP cache lays them out: 91 on chromosome 10; scaf_307, none of whose known variants lies within one base of a record, carries the empty indexed file the cache carries for a sequence without variants
